title: SiYangming/variant2qtl pipeline - params.genotype_input schema
description: Cohort-level genotype samplesheet: one row per analysis set (VCF and/or PLINK + phenotype).

id.errorMessage: Cohort id must be provided and cannot contain spaces

vcf.errorMessage: Optional VCF must have extension '.vcf' or '.vcf.gz'

bed.errorMessage: Optional PLINK bed must have extension '.bed'

bim.errorMessage: Optional PLINK bim must have extension '.bim'

fam.errorMessage: Optional PLINK fam must have extension '.fam'

phenotype.errorMessage: Phenotype file is required (plink-style FID IID trait)

covariates.errorMessage: Optional covariates file path cannot contain spaces
